Find codes in our Community Server!

TO REDEEM CODES:
TAB (PC) / SELECT (CONSOLE) > SETTINGS > CODES

A dark-fantasy RPG where death leaves its mark.

The Branded can never truly rest... Struggle or die. There is no other choice.

FIGHT with weighty, skill-based combat. Parry, dodge, break guards, and master an arsenal of weapons including swords, spears, axes, bows, wands, and legendary blades.

FORGE YOUR PATH. Choose your race, select your class, and create a build of your own. Rise from a lowly sellsword to something far greater. Master a unique class or become a Hybrid, wielding two weapons and combining their strengths.

ASCEND. Devour your way into becoming an Apostle, or sacrifice someone you love to ascend to the Godhand.

OPEN BETA:
Branded is in open beta. Expect bugs, balance issues & more chaos
